blocks.text: Another film executive is leaving Netflix as part of the ongoing layoffs at the streamer Wednesday. Sheroum Kim , who joined in January 2019 as Director of Independent Films, has been impacted by the cuts, Deadline has learned.

links.text: part of the ongoing layoffs at the streamer

blocks.text: We have also confirmed that Netflix features manager Sebastian Hernandez , who reported into Kim, is also departing.
Recent Netflix movies Kim was involved in include My Oxford Year, Roommates and Don’t Say Good Luck.

blocks.text: Kim joins Netflix VP Film Doug Belgrad who also is departing as part of the layoffs , which are impacting some 1,000 employees , 6% of the company’s workforce.

blocks.text: Before joining Netflix, Kim worked at STX as VP Development and subsequently SVP Production. During her tenure she worked on movies including The Edge of Seventeen , starring Hailee Steinfeld and Woody Harrelson, and I Feel Pretty starring Amy Schumer.

Prior to STX, Kim was Head of Development at 22 & Indiana Pictures, where she developed and executive produced the Clint Eastwood-Bradley Cooper hit American Sniper. She started out at Warner Bros and WME.
